Keep all other identity and rendering: the same cold gray box head/casing, original pose, long segmented limbs, outward raised blue hands, blue block boots, two red antenna tips, red cheeks, dark warm brown hand outline and controlled pencil/paper texture. Each oval eye keeps EXACTLY ONE large white glint SCREEN UPPER LEFT. Preserve original four chest controls in front order blue circle / yellow triangle / red circle / green rectangle. Upper-left illumination. Preserve the full original portrait composition and character proportions; no cropping, mirroring, shortened legs, reposing, new props, labels, panels or matte. Genuine transparent alpha background, no floor or cast shadow. Do not make any other redesign.
